prompt1_result.name: Case Series of Ventricular Tachycardia and Myocarditis From Programmed Cell-Death Protein-1 Inhibitor Treated With Infliximab
prompt1_result.ECG_start: accelerated idioventricular rhythm (AIVR) alternating with normal sinus rhythm (NSR)
prompt1_result.jisu_ dosage: prednisone 50 mg, then 1 mg/kg; methylprednisolone 1 g for 3 days
prompt1_result.jisu_regime: Initially prednisone 50 mg for neurological symptoms. For cardiac irAE, started on prednisone 1 mg/kg, then pulse dose methylprednisolone (1 g for 3 days).
prompt1_result.Symptoms_after_jisu_treatment: Arrhythmias improved with methylprednisolone but recurred upon steroid taper.
prompt1_result.ECG_after_jisu_treatment: Arrhythmias (AIVR, VT) continued initially with prednisone, improved with methylprednisolone, but recurred upon taper.
prompt1_result.ECG_after_yzj_treatment: Return of normal sinus rhythm (NSR) with narrow QRS conduction (2 weeks after infliximab).
prompt1_result.irAE_outcome: LVEF normalized after pulse dose steroids and remained normal. Troponin took 9 months to normalize.

prompt1_result.author: Allison Padegimas
prompt1_result.institution: Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania
prompt1_result.name: Case Series of Ventricular Tachycardia and Myocarditis From Programmed Cell-Death Protein-1 Inhibitor Treated With Infliximab
prompt1_result.irAE_type: perimyocarditis, ventricular tachycardia, complete heart block (CHB)
prompt1_result.irAE_Symptoms: sudden dyspnea on exertion, chest tightness
prompt1_result.ECG_start: diffuse ST elevations; later developed episodic VT and CHB
prompt1_result.jisu_ dosage: 1 mg/kg intravenously initially, then 2 g for 3 days
prompt1_result.jisu_regime: Intravenous methylprednisolone (1 mg/kg), then 2 g methylprednisolone for 3 days.
prompt1_result.Symptoms_after_yzj_treatment: Conduction block resolved, recovered from cardiogenic shock.
prompt1_result.ECG_after_yzj_treatment: Conduction block resolved. ECG 8 days after infliximab showed return of NSR with narrow QRS conduction.
prompt1_result.irAE_outcome: LVEF improved from 25% to 55% 17 days post-infliximab. Patient died 2 months later from fatal bacteremia and pulmonary embolism.
